summary: Actual Chromium execution of the Go/WASM bridge found two strict-boundary gaps: an invalid Title getter reentered gobiComposition.create() and advanced IDs before the outer call failed, and a proxy ownKeys trap could claim the expected names while Reflect.get accepted inherited values. Request accessor/data-descriptor snapshots plus a bridge-wide reentry guard during decoding; the native replay framing and primitive/range validation otherwise match the reviewed contract.
